recipe.build:
sed -ri '/signingConfigs.release/d ; /signingConfigs \{/,/^    \}/d' android/app/build.gradle
tar xf "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_NODEJS_LTS_PATH}" -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-${PROVISIONING_CACHE_NODEJS_LTS_VERSION}-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
export GRADLE_USER_HOME=/opt/gradle
npm install
npm run generate
npm run build
./node_modules/.bin/cap sync android
cd android
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/*unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
